description.value: McDonald's at Davie & Cardero is a 24/7 fast food location in Vancouver's West End, operating without a drive-through in a walkable, pedestrian-dense neighbourhood. The branch offers a full menu including breakfast, McCafé beverages, and takeaway service from a street-level unit with indoor seating. For touring cyclists moving through central Vancouver at any hour, it functions as a reliable food resupply stop.
